references.text: The Lord raised up a deliverer for Israel who rescued them—Othniel, son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.
The Israelites cried out to the Lord, and the Lord raised up a deliverer for them—Ehud, son of Gera.
God heard their cry and remembered his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
The outcry of Israel over their oppression has reached me, and I have seen how the Egyptians are oppressing them.
He looked upon them in their distress when he heard their cry. He remembered his covenant with them and had compassion because of his great love.
They put away the foreign gods and served the Lord. Then he could no longer bear to see Israel’s suffering.
In all their affliction, he was not afflicted. The angel of his presence saved them. In his love and mercy he redeemed them.
Then the Lord raised up Jerubbaal, Barak, Jephthah, and Samuel, and rescued you from your enemies around you, so that you could live in safety.
